description: Angular component for the Notes Page, managing notes display, search, creation, update, and deletion, interacts with NotesService and various child components.

classes.name: NotesPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component representing the notes page, handling notes management, searching, and user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribes to notes data from NotesService, and sets initial selected note.

methods.name: onCreateNewNote
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new note by setting creation mode.

methods.name: onSaveNote
methods.description: Saves a new or updated note, interacts with NotesService accordingly, and applies search filter if active.

methods.name: onSelectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by ID, updating the internal state.

methods.name: onDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and updates the selected note if necessary.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates the search term and filters notes based on the query.

methods.name: applySearch
methods.description: Filters the notes based on the search term.

methods.name: selectedNote
methods.description: Getter that returns the currently selected note or null if none or creating
